name: NGC 5582 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5582, a nearby spheroidal galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5582-hubble
story: Hubble took a quick look at the center of NGC 5582 in a census of the black holes and dense star clusters at the hearts of nearby galaxies. It was chosen because its core gives off faint X-rays.

claims.text: NGC 5582 is a target of Hubble program 12591
The program is a census of accreting black holes and nuclear star clusters in nearby galaxies
The program's targets are faint nearby spheroidal galaxies with faint X-ray cores
